ownership.quote: Fluidstack, a relatively young neocloud company... Founded in 2017, the company was named in February as the primary partner for a 1 gigawatt AI project backed by the French government

stage.quote: The company announced the Series A round on Monday. The lead investor was Situational Awareness, an AI-focused fund backed by Stripe Inc.'s founders. The investment values Fluidstack at $7.5 billion.
stage.note: Despite the unusually large size, the $830M July 2026 round was itself publicly labeled a 'Series A' (confirmed by SiliconANGLE and a Mishcon de Reya law-firm press release on the deal). Multiple outlets (TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Forbes, Dealroom, Tech Funding News) reported Fluidstack was in talks for, and by early September 2026 reportedly closed, a follow-on ~$1-1.5B round at an ~$18B valuation led by Jane Street/Situational Awareness, but no primary-source (company/investor) confirmation or an official round-name for that later raise was found within the research window, so the last confirmed priced round used here is the Series A.

accelerators.quote: listed in the Seedcamp portfolio as "Fluidstack"

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of publicly confirmed priced equity raised to date per SiliconANGLE/Mishcon de Reya (the $830M July 2026 Series A). Earlier 2025 reports of a ~$700M raise at a $7.5B valuation (Bloomberg/The Information, Dec 2025) appear to be the same round in negotiation before it closed at $830M/$7.5B. A subsequent ~$1-1.5B round at ~$18B valuation was widely reported (TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Forbes, Dealroom) as in talks/closing around April-September 2026 but is not included here because no primary confirmation of its close, amount, or terms was found; if confirmed, total funding would be materially higher (~$2.3-2.4B).
total_funding_usd.quote: Fluidstack Ltd., a startup helping Anthropic PBC build artificial intelligence data centers, has raised $830 million in funding.

last_round.quote: The company announced the Series A round on Monday. The lead investor was Situational Awareness, an AI-focused fund backed by Stripe Inc.'s founders. The investment values Fluidstack at $7.5 billion.

note: UK-founded (Oxford spinout, 2017) GPU/AI-data-center infrastructure builder; relocated HQ from the UK to New York after signing a $50B data center build deal with Anthropic (Nov 2025) covering Texas and New York sites. Also builds for Google (TPU hosting), Meta, Mistral, Black Forest Labs, and Poolside. Pulled out of a ~€10B/1GW French government-backed AI data center project in March 2026 to focus on US expansion. Valuation reportedly quadrupled from ~$7.5B to ~$18B within months in 2026 amid intense AI-infrastructure fundraising, though the later mega-round's close is not independently confirmed here.
